== Style pass (2026-10-15) ==
=== Missing data ===
* Service row "Decipher staff (rules "net rep" / PR)" has no specific citation; the Fantha Tracks interview may support it.
=== Possibly faulty data ===
* Start of playtesting: the 2018 Fantha Tracks interview has him recruited into ''Star Wars'' playtesting around ''A New Hope''; on WARS Radio episode 3 (9 July 2004, at 14:20) he said he had taken part in in-house playtests since Premiere. Both kept in the article with their refs (fantha, wr3).
=== Marginal cuts ===
* Lead sentence cut as a repeat of the Anagrams section: "The anagram list records [[Warrant Officer M'Kae]] as Mark McKay, "Mark Tuttle's radio name.""
* Radio hosting (Decipher WARS Radio 2004–2005, Decipher Games Radio 2005) moved from prose to the new Service table, cited to the [https://wiki.lotrtcgpc.net/wiki/Radio_Free_Decipher Radio Free Decipher / WARS / Games Radio index]. Sources list left as is for the scripted pass.
